name: Two Sum (Two Pointers)
description: Given a sorted array and target, find two indices whose values sum to the target. Uses two pointers (left and right) to solve in O(n) time.
aim: Find pair of elements summing to target by moving left pointer right when sum is too small and right pointer left when sum is too large.
howItWorks: Sort the array (or start with sorted)
If sum < target: left++ (need larger sum)
If sum > target: right-- (need smaller sum)

time.bestCase: First two elements sum to target
time.worstCase: Pair at center or no pair exists

complexity.spaceDescription: Two pointer variables only (assumes array is sorted)

realWorld: Finding pairs with specific difference in sorted data
Checking if sorted array can form arithmetic sequence
whenToUse: When O(n) solution needed with O(1) space
alternatives: Hash Map — O(n) time and space, works on unsorted arrays
Brute force O(n²) — only for very small inputs
Binary search — O(n log n) total, for each element binary search complement
